frontier.hypothesis: The target's window needs BOTH halves of what s15 measured separately: the a2 base emitted after the multiply chain (base-last, which wins the target's slot 1) AND the constant still attached to s4. The only thing separating them is combine's reassociation of (plus m (plus r4 -K)) into (plus (plus m -K) r4), which fires because the r4 - K value has exactly one use.
frontier.mechanism: combine.c folds a constant across a nested plus when the inner sum is single-use; a second, genuinely consumed use of the same r4 - K value in the same half would leave the inner sum multi-use and force it to be materialised on its own, in its late position, as addiu <dest>,s4,-K. This is the one term the 61-form sweep never varied - every form used the base value exactly once.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate spellings in which half 1's (s32)r4 - 0xC value has a second real consumer inside the same half (for example the half-2 base spelled as that value minus 0xD, or the s.zero1C store reading it twice through the accumulate), combined with the base-last association; gate each variant on build_insns == 176, and for every variant that stays at 176 disassemble the 0x3594 window and check specifically for addiu <reg>,s4,-0xC emitted AFTER addiu a0,sp,0x10. s13 already measured the cross-half carrier at 31/178, so the second use must live inside the half, not span the third rand call.

frontier.hypothesis: The a2 base can reach INSN_PRIORITY 4 without adding an instruction only by becoming a data consumer of the in-block gp load, and the one value in the window that is both loaded and semantically usable in the base is D_800A3418 itself - so a spelling in which the base's addiu takes a loaded operand and the multiply chain takes the invariant one may swap the two chains' depths at zero instruction cost.
frontier.mechanism: priority(insn) = max over LOG_LINKS of priority(pred) + insn_cost - 1, and insn_cost is 2 exactly for a load's data consumer (sched.c:1497), which is why insns 206/208 reach 4 while 211 stays at 3. Making 211 a consumer of 205 lifts it to 4 and it then outranks 240/242 on the first rank_for_schedule criterion, before the class and LUID terms are ever reached.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate re-associations of a2_offset = (s32)r4 - K + ((u32)(D_800A3418 * M) >> 0xF) in which the addiu that survives combine reads the loaded D_800A3418-derived value rather than s4 - and check each against the target's operand order at 4DEC0/4DEE8 - then capture BB2_PRIO_DEBUG=1 for any variant that stays at 176 and confirm whether insn 211's contrib line changes from cost=1 to cost=2. Note s12's overshoot argument is retired by s14, so a priority-4 base is not disqualified in advance.

frontier.hypothesis: Because a per-half named local for ANY sub-expression of the a2 chain is LICM-hoisted (s15, 44/48 forms at 153 insns), while a2_offset itself survives only because it is written twice per half, the multi-set requirement is a property of the CARRIER, not of the expression - so an existing loop local that is already multi-set for its own real reasons could carry the base without inventing a carrier and without triggering the hoist.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c:705 accepts a movable only when n_times_set for the destination is 1; a local that is genuinely written twice per iteration for its own purpose is never a movable, and after combine collapses its redundant sets it can still reach sched1 with reg_n_sets 1, which is the birthing_insn_p (sched.c:2505) precondition for the LAUNCH boost. The Judge's constraint bans INVENTED multi-write carriers, not existing ones.
frontier.next_probe: Inventory the loop's existing multi-set locals (a0_offset, a2_offset, ret, i, and the loop-scope pointers) and enumerate, for each, a form in which the a2 base value is produced into that local at a point where the local's own live range has already ended within the same half - s13 measured the cross-rand-call cases at 30/178 and 31/178, so restrict the enumeration to intra-half positions after the local's last real read, gate on build_insns == 176, and disassemble every 176-instruction survivor.

judge_constraints: No fresh (invented) local may be written more than once to act as a staging carrier for the a2-site base `(s32)r4 - K` or for any other value in this function, under any name; the existing-local borrow quadrant (staged-value-reused-variable, all six bounds) and the alternate-chassis route (frontier item 2, e.g. the z3 guard-duplicated while) remain open.
